name: Hooksett's Best After School and Summer Camp
description_short: A licensed summer camp and before/after-school program in Hooksett, NH, for ages 4.9 to 12. Summer camp runs 6:30 AM to 6 PM on weekdays, with themed weeks, martial arts, dance, sports, arts and crafts, STEM activities and weekly field trips.

source.title: Hooksett's BEST After School and Summer Camp

warnings: This is the camp's own homepage. It lists no summer dates, prices or ages, and there are no 2027 season details.
Prices, schedule and availability are only shared after you submit the contact form.
The page mostly describes the program in general and includes the school-year after-school program, not only summer camp.
unknowns: Season year and 2027 summer session dates
Tuition and weekly rates (only given after you fill out the contact form)
Daily hours and whether extended care is offered in summer
Whether lunch or snacks are included
Registration link and when registration opens
Deposit, refund and financial aid policies
Whether summer camp is day-only (it most likely is, but the page doesn't say)

low_confidence.quote: We are currently accepting a limited number of students for both our Before/After School and Summer Camp

changes: Added the Summer Camp page the draft missed: ages 4.9 to 12, $227 a week (a 'pick your weeks' option costs more), hours 6:30 AM to 6 PM, weekly field trips and pizza parties, state scholarships accepted.
Set age_max 12 and left age_min empty: the camp says 4.9 years, which is not a whole age.
Set financial_aid true because the camp accepts state child care scholarships.
No year or session dates appear on either page, so season_year stays empty and check_draft fails on it.
open_questions: The camp posts no year or dates, only a weekly price and asks families to fill in a contact form. Hold until it posts summer 2027 dates, or publish with a season year we can't source?
